FICTIONAL QA DOCUMENT - NOT LEGAL ADVICE OR A TEMPLATE FOR SIGNING

Included revisions and optional new work

C1. Parties: Pebble Arc Design and Harbor Kite Books. All identities and records are fictional demo data.

C2. The fixed fee is USD 900 for an estimated 12 hours. The designer will deliver on November 20, 2026, after receiving the approved creative brief on November 16.

C3. The designer will present two initial logo concepts. The client will select one for final refinement. Final files for the selected logo are SVG and PNG with transparent backgrounds.

C4. One consolidated refinement round is included for the selected concept. It may include a color-palette change, a typeface adjustment and minor spacing corrections. It does not include a new logo concept. In this fictional project the client has not yet used the included round.

C5. Three-dimensional animation, an animated logo and production of business cards are excluded. Social-profile image deliverables and source-file delivery are not addressed in this agreement.

C6. A different delivery date or additional deliverable requires explicit approval of its scope, total fee and date. No response, a request for an estimate or a tentative expression of interest is not approval.

C7. Fictional acceptance record: both parties accepted C1-C6 on November 14, 2026. No other amendment has been accepted.
